summary: Climb Bio, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Open Market Sale Agreement with Jefferies LLC for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $100 million of common stock under an existing shelf registration statement. The filing is a routine capital markets activity, not a special situation. Shares may be sold on Nasdaq at prevailing market prices with Jefferies receiving up to 3% commission. No specific terms, premium, or transformative event are involved. This is an ordinary shelf takedown under Rule 415, not a special situation.
